title: Staff Onboarding
markdown:
The **staff_onboarding** module (`openexecutive.staff_onboarding`) onboards a *person into the company* — a new hire, exec or IC, fractional or full-time. It is distinct from the company-setup wizard in `onboarding/` (which captures the company profile) and from the people roster in `people/`. It is a first-class subsystem, a sibling to `talent`, and it leans on the context Open Executive already holds: the company profile, departments, the people roster, company-doc RAG, and the talent pipeline.

## Entities

Three Pydantic models persist to the shared `episodic_memory.db` (idempotent `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, no migration tooling), mirroring `talent/store.py`:

- **`OnboardingTemplate`** (`onboarding_templates`) — a reusable, role/department blueprint: an ordered set of task specs (phase + owner-by-role + due offset from start date), the brief sections to generate, a ramp length, and a check-in cadence. Default templates (`generic`, `engineering`, `go_to_market`, `finance`) are seeded idempotently at startup; operator edits are never clobbered.
- **`OnboardingPlan`** (`onboarding_plans`) — one per hire. Carries the hire, role, start date, manager/buddy, the generated welcome brief + reading list, the pre-generated ramp segments + the next-segment index, and optional `engagement_id`/`candidate_id` links back to talent. `completion_pct` is computed from the plan's tasks on read (never stored).
- **`OnboardingTask`** (`onboarding_tasks`) — one checklist item: phase (`pre_start` / `week_1` / `day_30` / `day_60` / `day_90`), category, owner person, due date, and status (`pending` / `in_progress` / `done` / `skipped`; skipped is excluded from completion).

## Instantiation

`service.instantiate_plan` turns a template into a concrete plan: each task spec becomes a task with a real `due_date` (`start_date + due_offset_days`) and an owner resolved against the plan/roster (`hire` → person_id, `manager`/`buddy` → the plan's ids, `department_head` → the department's configured head). Plans start in `draft`; orchestration and the ramp are fired explicitly on activation, not at instantiation.

## Content workflow — `role_onboarding`

A registered workflow (`WORKFLOW_REGISTRY["role_onboarding"]`, section People) generates the role-tailored **welcome brief** section by section via the role's domain specialist — resolved by department `specialist_key` → a function-name map → `cso` fallback, so any role gets a relevant lens. Sections: company landscape (`cso`), state of the function (domain specialist), people map (`chro` + roster), a 30/60/90 plan, and week-one questions. It also generates an optional per-day **ramp drip** and writes the brief, reading list, and ramp segments back onto the plan. `ramp_days` is tri-state: omitted = use the template's value, `0` = force no drip, `>0` = override.

## Chat + /today integration

The subsystem is driven and surfaced from chat exactly as `talent` is:

- **Chat tools** (`orchestrator/onboarding_tools.py`, spliced into the Executive's `_ALL_SKILL_TOOLS` / `_ALL_SKILL_HANDLERS`): `list_onboarding_plans`, `get_onboarding_plan`, `list_onboarding_templates`, `create_onboarding_plan`, `complete_onboarding_task`, `advance_onboarding_plan`, and `start_onboarding` (runs the workflow and returns the brief).
- **Proactive briefing** (`briefing/onboarding_digest.py`): a compact one-line-per-plan digest joins the per-turn chat `briefing_context` (beside the talent digest) and powers a `/today` onboarding section, so the Executive knows who is onboarding and what's overdue without being asked.

## Activation — drip, kickoff & check-ins

`service.activate_plan` flips the plan to `active` and enqueues three families of scheduled action (all idempotent; the async scheduler does the sending — see the Scheduler section):

- **Ramp drip** (`onboarding_ramp`) — walks the plan's pre-generated `ramp_segments` via an atomic claim that advances `ramp_next_index`, one per business day, and self-terminates when exhausted. No-ops without a roster `person_id` + segments.
- **Kickoff** (`onboarding_kickoff`, one-shot) — a welcome notice to the hire's department channel *only when one is configured*, plus intro-1:1 nudge DMs to the manager and buddy.
- **Milestone check-ins** (`onboarding_checkin`, day 7/30/60/90) — DM the hire + manager and advance the plan's phase forward-only. Past-due milestones are skipped at activation. Reply-folding rides the chat tools (the `wait_for_human` resume path is a Phase-7 item), so a manager's reply lets the Executive mark tasks done or advance the phase via its onboarding tools.
